Membership Info

Join the family and be part of a winning tradition.

Explore Membership Options

Joining East Bay Volleyball Club opens the door to a host of opportunities for both recreational and competitive play.

Nestled in the vibrant community of Brentwood, California, we welcome individuals and families looking to immerse themselves in the exciting world of volleyball. By joining our club, you will experience:

  • Skill Development: Top-tier coaching dedicated to individual and team growth.
  • Sportsmanship: A focus on character building and positive team dynamics.
  • Camaraderie: Lifelong friendships built both on and off the court.
  • Competitive Opportunities: Ranging from local scrimmages to regional travel tournaments.

Flexible Fees and Options

  • 12U: $2,750
  • 13U, 14U: $3,000
  • 15U, 16U, 17U: $3,250
  • Payment Plan Options: 2-5 months

Commitment Deposit: $700. Due on commitment night (pay in full and receive a 5% discount!)

Cancellation Policy: Canceling the signed commitment will require a $350 cancellation fee.

Apparel Package Included: 2 Jerseys, 1 Backpack, 1 Club T-Shirt

Important Payment Information

Please review our standardized payment policies below.

Processing Date

Payments will automatically be processed on the 15th of each month.

Card Authorization

All families must leave a credit card number on file to be charged if payment is not timely.
